title.zh: 一张图看懂芯片制造中的 Plasma
title.en: Plasma in chip manufacturing at a glance

subtitle.zh: 从粒子分工，到刻蚀、成膜与损伤控制
subtitle.en: Particle roles, etching, deposition, and damage control

heading.zh: 01 认识 Plasma 与 02 粒子分工

body.zh: 把工艺气体（气体分子）送入放电腔，形成等离子体作用于晶圆。电子（能量高）通过碰撞解离气体分子；中性自由基参与多方向化学反应；正离子通过鞘层，沿电场加速轰击晶圆。
body.en: Feed process-gas molecules into a discharge chamber to create plasma acting on a wafer. Energetic electrons dissociate gas molecules by collision; neutral radicals react chemically from multiple directions; positive ions accelerate through the sheath along the electric field toward the wafer.

heading.zh: 03 图形刻蚀与 04 薄膜沉积

body.zh: 刻蚀将掩膜图形转移到目标材料中；图中标有掩膜、目标层、衬底、离子轰击与挥发产物。沉积通过活化反应或提供溅射材料成膜，路线包括 PECVD、PEALD、溅射 PVD；后者图示 Ar⁺ 轰击靶材形成溅射原子。
body.en: Etching transfers a mask pattern into the target; labels include mask, target, substrate, ion bombardment, volatile products. Deposition activates reactions or supplies sputtered material through PECVD, PEALD, or sputter PVD; the latter shows Ar⁺ bombarding a target to generate sputtered atoms.

heading.zh: 05 去胶清洗与 06 表面改性

body.zh: 去胶去掉有机物，同时保护底层；处理前后的有机胶/目标层/衬底图展示等离子体去除和挥发产物。表面改性调整最表层，为后续界面服务；化学基团、材料表面、衬底的变化用于后续键合。
body.en: Resist removal removes organics while protecting underlying layers; before/after resist/target/substrate diagrams show plasma removal and volatile products. Surface modification changes the top surface for later interfaces; chemical groups on material/substrate prepare for bonding.

heading.zh: 07 损伤控制与 08 路线选择

body.zh: 效率、均匀性与损伤一起管理，控制能量、输运、温度，并关注晶圆分布中的工艺窗口与损伤风险。直接路线：等离子体在晶圆附近，用于刻蚀或沉积。远程路线：上游产生等离子体，中性物种到达晶圆。热/湿法：加热或化学反应去除或改性表面。
body.en: Manage efficiency, uniformity, and damage together through energy, transport, and temperature, checking wafer distributions and damage risk. Direct plasma forms near the wafer for etch/deposition. Remote plasma forms upstream and delivers neutral species. Thermal/wet routes use heat or chemistry to remove or modify surfaces.

uncertain: 页末水印与实质文字或图示区域重叠；figureCrop保留完整图表，未猜测补画遮挡区域。
